//go:build !functional

package metaengine

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)

// One-time capture source, retained inert beside the independent schema-1 fixtures.
func TestCaptureRecoverySchemaOne(t *testing.T) {
	importing, _ := importedRecoveryWithPolicy(t, true)
	complete := completedRecoveryFixture(t, true)
	for name, state := range map[string]scopedState{"importing": importing, "complete": complete} {
		data, err := json.Marshal(state)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var restored scopedState
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &restored); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Printf("RECOVERY_FIXTURE %s %s\n", name, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data))
	}
}
